title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Customer Ledger, Debtor Prioritization & In-App Android Updater
highlights: Customer Ledger in Customer Master: Directly view and download customer ledger and transaction history without going through invoice payments.
Smart Debtor Prioritization: Customers with pending or partial dues automatically float to the top of the customer list with outstanding badges and filter chips.
Direct Stock Restock: Easily edit and adjust stock in Product Master and one-click quick restock from Inventory Control suggestions.
Seamless In-App Android Updater: Download updates directly with chunk progress bar and one-tap install prompt without opening Chrome.
Zero-Overflow Display Engine: Perfectly rendered dialogs and action bars across all Large/Medium zoom levels.
fixes: Integrated Android PackageInstaller with FileProvider for seamless in-app APK installation.
Enabled stock editing in Product Master and added audit-logged stock adjustments.
Added Customer Ledger icon and popup menu to Customer Master cards.
Fixed horizontal action bar clipping and dialog title vertical wrap on display zoom.
